Situation Report — 29 Oct 2026 (last 2 hours)

  • US strikes on Bandar-e-Jask (21:55 UTC): Four missiles struck the Iranian Navy Jask Naval Base.
  • Strikes & air incidents
  • IRGC says it confronted a hostile fighter near Qeshm and forced it to leave (20:55 UTC).
  • CENTCOM chief briefed former President Trump on options for strikes on Iran (20:53 UTC).
  • Saudi–Houthi exchanges
  • Saudi air defenses intercepted two ballistic missiles from Yemen; debris/shrapnel fell in Riyadh; blasts heard. Reports of 12 killed in Yemen (21:43–21:05 UTC).
  • Gulf / Hormuz
  • Iran demands the US provide independent evidence that mines were cleared from the Strait of Hormuz (20:40 UTC).
  • Diplomacy & inspections
  • Mediators are pressing Iran to allow IAEA inspectors access to nuclear sites (21:30 UTC).
  • Israeli media report Israel will warn the UN that Iran is rebuilding its missile program.
  • Domestic / West Bank
  • Israeli raids across the West Bank left Palestinians injured and arrested (20:40 UTC).
  • Israel banned travel for Brad Lander after his detention in the occupied West Bank (21:10 UTC).
  • Economic
  • Intel sector shares fell ~18% after an Israeli factory blast (20:31 UTC).
  • Threat trend: Escalating — recent US strikes, strike-option briefings, air confrontations and regional missile launches/interceptions indicate rising military activity.
  • 🟢 Good News: Saudi interceptors successfully shot down missiles headed toward Riyadh, reducing direct damage to the city.

6.en:
Situation Report — 29 Oct 2026 (last 6 hours)

  • Active strike: U.S. strikes on Bandar-e-Jask, southern Iran. Four missiles struck the IRIN Jask Naval Base (report at 21:55 UTC).
  • U.S. military movements: CENTCOM chief briefed President Trump; Trump met Admiral Cooper. At least 10 U.S. transport aircraft landed at Israeli bases in the past 24 hours. Reports of aircraft moving into position for strikes.
  • Regional air activity: IRGC Aerospace Force confronted a hostile fighter jet near Qeshm Island and forced it to leave. Reports of American/Israeli fighter jets conducting probing/simulated airstrike rounds over northeastern and central-eastern Iraq.
  • Yemen–Saudi exchanges: Ansarallah/Houthis claim five missile operations against Saudi airports and oil facilities and say they attacked Ras Tanura. Saudi Arabia intercepted ballistic missiles; debris/shrapnel fell in Riyadh and blasts were heard. 12 reportedly killed in Yemen (report).
  • Maritime/inspections: Iran demands independent evidence from the U.S. that mines were cleared from the Strait of Hormuz (Iranian statement).
  • Israeli domestic/adjacent developments: Palestinians injured and arrested in West Bank raids; access restrictions at Al-Aqsa tightened. Israel bans travel for Brad Lander after detention. Election reporting: no overall majority; Likud reported as winning the most votes (preliminary).
  • Other: Intel-sector stocks fell after an Israeli factory blast was reported (market reaction noted).
  • Threat trend: Escalating — supported by U.S. kinetic strikes, increased U.S. positioning, active fighter operations, and concurrent missile attacks from Yemen.
  • 🟢 Good News: Saudi interceptors reportedly shot down incoming ballistic missiles; debris fell but interceptions were successful.

  • תנועות צבאיות של ארה"ב: מפקד CENTCOM עדכן את הנשיא טראמפ; טראמפ נפגש עם אדמירל קופר. לפחות 10 מטוסי תובלה אמריקאיים נחתו בבסיסים ישראליים ב-24 השעות האחרונות. דיווחים על מטוסים הנעים לעמדות תקיפה.
  • פעילות אווירית אזורית: כוח החלל של משמרות המהפכה התעמת עם מטוס קרב עוין סמוך לאי קישם והוציאו אותו מאזור. דיווחים על מטוסי קרב אמריקאיים/ישראלים המבצעים סבבי סריקות/הדמיית תקיפה בצפון-מזרח ומרכז-מזרח עיראק.
  • חזית תימן–ערב הסעודית: אנצראללה/החות'ים הודיעו על חמישה מבצעים בטילים נגד נמלי תעופה ומתקני נפט סעודיים וטענו על התקפה על ראס טנורה. סעודיה ירתה מטילים יורדי; שרידים נפלו בריאד ויש דיווחים על פיצוצים. בתימן דווחו 12 הרוגים.
  • ים ומשא: איראן דורשת מהארה"ב הוכחה עצמאית לכך שניקתה מוקשים ממצר הורמוז (הודעת איראן).
  • עניינים בישראל ובשטחים: פצועים ומעצרים בפשיטות ברחבי הגדה; הגבלות גישה בהר הבית/אל-אקסה גוברות. ישראל אסרה על נסיעות של ברד לנדר לאחר מעצרו. דיווחים על תוצאות הבחירות: אין רוב ברור; הליכוד קיבל את מרב הקולות (ראשוני).
  • אחר: מניות מגזר המודיעין צנחו לאחר דיווח על פיצוץ במפעל בישראל (תגובה שוק).
  • מגמת איום: ההסלמה מתקיימת — נתמכת על ידי תקיפות אמריקאיות קינטיות, תגבור מעמדה אמריקאי, פעילות קרבית בשטחים סמוכים ותקיפות טילים משולבות בתימן.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: מערכות ההגנה הסעודיות דיווחו על יירוטי טילים בלילה; טילים יורדים הושמדו לפי הדיווחים.

Situation report — 29 Oct 2026 (last 24h)

  • Active strikes: U.S. strikes struck Bandar-e-Jask (southern Iran). Four missiles hit the Jask Naval Base (21:55 UTC report).
  • Regional missile exchanges: Saudi air defences intercepted Houthi ballistic missiles over Riyadh; debris/shrapnel fell and blasts were reported. Reuters/liveuamap report 12 killed in Yemen. Ansarallah/Houthis announced five operations vs. Saudi airports and oil facilities.
  • IRGC reported confronting a hostile fighter jet near Qeshm Island and forcing it to leave the area.
  • U.S. and Israeli fighter-jet activity reported over northeastern and central-eastern Iraq; described as probing/simulated airstrike rounds.
  • U.S. military moves: CENTCOM chief briefed President Trump on strike options. Large-scale U.S. airlift reported; at least 10 U.S. transport aircraft landed at Israeli bases in the past 24 hours. Multiple reports of aircraft moving into position for potential strikes.
  • Iran publicly demanded independent evidence from the U.S. that mines in the Strait of Hormuz were cleared.
  • Political/diplomatic: Mediators pressed Iran to allow IAEA inspectors to visit nuclear sites (report). Lebanon’s president said key issues with Israel remain unresolved after U.S.-mediated talks. Israel reportedly will warn the UN that Iran is rebuilding its missile programme.
  • On Israel/Palestinians: Israeli raids across the West Bank injured and arrested Palestinians. Israel banned travel for Brad Lander after his detention.
  • Economic impact: Intel-sector shares fell after an Israeli factory blast (stocks down ~18% reported).

Bottom line: Threat trend: Escalating.

  • 🟢 Good News: Saudi defenses intercepted incoming missiles over Riyadh. U.S. transport aircraft landed at Israeli bases (reinforcements/logistics reported).
